title: EGM: Efficient Visual Grounding Language Models
authors: Guanqi Zhan*, Changye Li*, Zhijian Liu, Yao Lu, Yi Wu, Song Han, Ligeng Zhu
summary: Efficient spatial reasoning with small vision-language models. Curated reasoning data, supervised fine-tuning, and reinforcement learning improve visual and amodal grounding.

title: Inferring Dynamic Physical Properties from Video Foundation Models
authors: Guanqi Zhan*, Xianzheng Ma*, Weidi Xie, Andrew Zisserman
summary: Do video foundation models learn the physics behind motion? Probing generative and self-supervised representations for elasticity, viscosity, and friction, with PhysVid evaluating transfer from simulated to real-world videos.

title: Grounded 3D-Aware Spatial Vision-Language Modeling
authors: An-Chieh Cheng, Yang Fu, Yatai Ji, Ligeng Zhu, Guanqi Zhan, Zhuoyang Zhang, Zhaojing Yang, Song Han, Yao Lu, Pavlo Molchanov, Vidya Nariyambut Murali, Jan Kautz, Xiaolong Wang, Hongxu Yin, Sifei Liu
summary: Connecting visual evidence to metric 3D space. Grounded visual chain-of-thought and monocular 3D grounding help vision-language models reason about object locations, distances, and spatial relationships.

title: TARGO and TARGO-Net: Benchmarking Target-driven Object Grasping under Occlusions
authors: Yan Xia*, Ran Ding*, Ziyuan Qin*, Guanqi Zhan, Kaichen Zhou, Long Yang, Hao Dong, Daniel Cremers
summary: Grasping a chosen object in a partially observed world. An occlusion-aware benchmark and a target–scene model combine shape completion with clutter context for robust target-driven robotic grasping.

title: ELIP: Enhanced Visual-Language Foundation Models for Image Retrieval
authors: Guanqi Zhan*, Yuanpei Liu*, Kai Han, Weidi Xie, Andrew Zisserman
summary: Adapting frozen vision-language foundation models efficiently. Text-conditioned visual prompts, hard-sample mining, and curated training data align visual representations with language queries and improve retrieval generalization.

title: A General Protocol to Probe Large Vision Models for 3D Physical Understanding
authors: Guanqi Zhan, Chuanxia Zheng, Weidi Xie, Andrew Zisserman
summary: What physical knowledge emerges from large-scale pretraining? A common protocol probes generative and discriminative models for geometry, materials, support, lighting, occlusion, and depth, connecting learned representations to 3D physical understanding.

title: Amodal Ground Truth and Completion in the Wild
authors: Guanqi Zhan, Chuanxia Zheng, Weidi Xie, Andrew Zisserman
summary: Inferring complete objects beyond what is visible. Pretrained Stable Diffusion features support amodal segmentation, while a 3D-driven data pipeline creates real-image ground truth for evaluating completion with MP3D-Amodal.

title: InstructNav: Zero-shot System for Generic Instruction Navigation in Unexplored Environment
authors: Yuxing Long*, Wenzhe Cai*, Hongcheng Wang, Guanqi Zhan, Hao Dong
summary: From language and visual observations to embodied decisions. Dynamic Chain-of-Navigation and multi-sourced value maps guide robots through unexplored environments under diverse instructions, without navigation-specific training.

title: Broadcasting Support Relations Recursively from Local Dynamics for Object Retrieval in Clutters
authors: Yitong Li*, Ruihai Wu*, Haoran Lu, Chuanruo Ning, Yan Shen, Guanqi Zhan, Hao Dong
summary: Reasoning about physical dependencies before acting. Local dynamics propagate through a support graph to infer which objects support others and plan step-by-step object retrieval in cluttered real-world scenes.

title: Learning Environment-Aware Affordance for 3D Articulated Object Manipulation under Occlusions
authors: Ruihai Wu*, Kai Cheng*, Yan Shen, Chuanruo Ning, Guanqi Zhan, Hao Dong
summary: Learning where a robot can act under occlusion. Environment-aware affordances incorporate surrounding objects and robot constraints, using contrastive learning to connect 3D observations with feasible articulated-object manipulation.

title: Score-PA: Score-based 3D Part Assembly
authors: Junfeng Cheng, Mingdong Wu, Ruiyuan Zhang, Guanqi Zhan, Chao Wu, Hao Dong
summary: Generating coherent 3D structures from unassembled parts. Score-based modeling captures diverse plausible assemblies, with a fast predictor–corrector sampler for efficient generation of part configurations.

title: A Tri-Layer Plugin to Improve Occluded Detection
authors: Guanqi Zhan, Weidi Xie, Andrew Zisserman
summary: Understanding the scene structure behind occlusion. Joint reasoning over an object, its occluder, and its occludee improves detection and segmentation of partially hidden objects.

title: Generative 3D Part Assembly via Dynamic Graph Learning
authors: Jialei Huang*, Guanqi Zhan*, Qingnan Fan, Kaichun Mo, Lin Shao, Baoquan Chen, Leonidas Guibas, Hao Dong
summary: From a set of parts to a coherent 3D object. Dynamic graph reasoning learns relationships between parts and iteratively refines their poses, generating plausible assemblies without semantic part labels.

title: DLGAN: Disentangling Label-Specific Fine-Grained Features for Image Manipulation
authors: Guanqi Zhan*, Yihao Zhao*, Bingchan Zhao, Haoqi Yuan, Baoquan Chen, Hao Dong
summary: Controllable generation through disentangled representations. Separating label-specific and label-independent features enables discrete attributes and reference images to guide fine-grained manipulation and cross-domain interpolation.
